samples: This program prints a plain-text invoice statement for two sample customers, showing each customer name, the number of line items, and the invoice total in fixed-width columns. It sorts the sample invoices by customer name before printing them, then prints a final grand total across both invoices. The imported invoice module is responsible for calculating each invoice total with its percentage discount, so this program is mainly a reporting/formatting wrapper rather than the billing logic itself.

This program prints a simple plain-text report for two sample invoices, showing each customer, how many line items they have, and their discounted total in fixed-width columns. It sorts the invoices by customer name before printing, then prints a final grand total for both invoices combined. The imported invoice module provides the data types and the exact cent-rounded total calculations, so this is useful if you want a small reporting entry point rather than invoice math itself.
